title: Red fish under map
body:

This Fish is normally seen by some who is glitching or has lagged under the map. It seems to be an easter egg that the developers put there for fun.

If you are confused for some reason there's a red fish under the map that i found after i spawned there

How to get to the fish you need plot 3 with a basement and leave the game and rejoin with a different plot or find someone's plot located at plot 3 with a basement and hope you don't get kicked by them and just wait for them to leave
